_comment: Vendor field library (src/vendor-field-library.ts). Field lists are generated by npm run library:fields from the names each parser reads or captures, from JSON samples, and from Zeek headers and key=value lines in the sample library. A syslog sample's Splunk field list is not copied. log_time is common: the parser synthesizes it, so it must not anchor a fallback chain. An open entry drops || fallbacks around a field it lists. Close an entry only after checking it against the vendor documentation for that version, including fields the Cribl Source adds (syslog, HEC); set reviewedBy/reviewedAt/version. Fields seen on builds are kept per install in the app KV store, never in this file.
